propositions: The dedup suite had no end-to-end test crossing the apply-to-differ seam with a control proving that the recorded comment skip actually depends on BindingStore.is_comment_mapped rather than passing vacuously.

A real envelope posted via _record_comment_id against a real BindingStore, then re-diffed with _diff_comments against that same store, must skip the recorded comment while emitting an unrecorded control comment.
When is_comment_mapped is forced to False on the store instance, the previously-skipped recorded comment must be re-emitted, proving the skip guard discriminates rather than being inert.
The test uses the real acli_cli_ops.add_comment and ACLI_SUCCESS_ENVELOPE fixture (stubbed only at _run_acli), a real BindingStore, and real recording/diffing paths to eliminate seeded invariants.
The Jira-side comment body diverges from all local bodies, preventing the secondary body-equality skip from masking an inert primary id-identity skip.
